problem:
In **ascending order,** the $x$-coordinates of the points where the hyperbola $8{x}^{2}-5{y}^{2}=27$ intersects the line $y=x$ are

$\,x=$
{{field-1}}$\,$ and $\,x=$
{{field-2}}.
worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $y=x,$ we first replace $y$ with $x$ in the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}8{x}^{2}-5{y}^{2} & =27 \\ 8{x}^{2}-5{x}^{2} & =27 \\ 3{x}^{2} & =27 \\ {x}^{2} & =9 \\ x & =\pm 3\end{aligned}
$$

So, in ascending order, the $x$-coordinates of the points of intersection are
$x=-3$ and $x=3.$
